svg.title: An object, its class, and their names
svg.desc: A gray box at the left, the module's namespace, holds the names scout and Robot. Tag 1: scout has an arrow to a red box, a Robot object, that holds its own names name and battery, with arrows to a str object 'Scout' and an int object 100. Tag 2: Robot has an arrow to a red box, the class object, of type type, that holds the names total_robots, with an arrow to an int object 2, and __init__, with an arrow to a function object. Tag 3: a dashed arrow from the Robot object down to the class object: the object's link to its class.
